comments.author: Grimmturd
comments.body:
Memorial Album is fairly easy to complete for this figurehead with r10 handicrafts.

Sculpting Figure of Land Animals - 200k investment in Cabo Verde
~craft all 4 in the book

Sculpting Figure of Marine Life - Buy from Craft Shop in Riga, Stockholm, Danzig,Lubeck, Oslo, or Edinburgh
~craft the turtle and the sea monster

Sculpting Figure of Bird - Buy from Craft Shop in Genoa
~craft the Phoenix

All done. Talk to Kara Mehmet in Istanbul to get reward.

comments.author: Snipe
comments.body: Don't forget, all figureheads for the memorial album can also be bought if one does not want to craft, except one, called the Leopard, which requires rank 4 in handicrafts
